review.reason: The mapped tees, greens, fairways, bunkers, and water are represented clearly, and the greens read as continuous natural putting surfaces. Hole 1’s fairway stripes run lengthwise rather than across the fairway, so the illustration does not meet the stripe-direction requirement.

issues.detail: The broad upper fairway has horizontal bands running along its left-to-right direction of play. Reorient them so the bands cross the fairway edge-to-edge, perpendicular to play.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, the fairway reads as lengthwise-striped rather than as a fairway with the required transverse mowing pattern.
